item.title: Hong Kong political heavyweights trade barbs after lawmaker filmed driving against flow of traffic
item.description: Hong Kong politician Regina Ip has engaged in a fiery text message exchange with a veteran of the city’s biggest political party after a lawmaker from Ip’s own party was filmed driving against the flow of traffic last week. item.title: Pok Fu Lam construction workers scale scaffolding in protest over unpaid wages from firm linked to Tai Po fire
item.description: Construction workers at a residential estate in Pok Fu Lam have staged a protest demanding unpaid wages after their project – managed by a contractor linked to the Wang Fuk Court fire – was halted following the blaze. item.title: UK’s Keir Starmer arrives in China to defend ‘pragmatic’ partnership, expected to raise Jimmy Lai issue
item.description: British Prime Minister Keir Starmer arrived in Beijing on Wednesday to meet with Chinese leader Xi Jinping, hoping to restore long fraught relations. item.title: 6 months’ jail for PolyU applicant who shoved HK$50k bribe into lecturer’s pocket
item.description: A 39-year-old businessman has been jailed for six months after offering a HK$50,000 bribe to a senior Hong Kong Polytechnic University (PolyU) lecturer. Businessman Kang Jie pleaded guilty at the West Kowloon Magistrates’ Courts to offering an advantage to an agent and was jailed on Thursday, according to a press release from the Independent Commission […]

item.title: Hong Kong mulls legislation to tackle AI ‘deepfake’ porn – official
item.description: An inter-departmental working group set up by Hong Kong’s justice department is studying whether to set up legislation for cases involving indecent images generated by Artificial Intelligence (AI), following an AI-porn scandal at a local university. item.title: HK$4.5 billion raised in public fund for Tai Po fire victims, gov’t says
item.description: Around HK$4.5 billion has been raised in the Hong Kong government’s public donation fund for victims of the deadly Tai Po fire. item.title: Hong Kong to address comfort, hygiene concerns over seat belt law, as lawmakers urge review
item.description: Authorities will address comfort and hygiene concerns over a new law requiring passengers to wear seat belts on buses, transport chief Mable Chan has said.
